fields.scope_quantifiers: the V1 adjudicator C3 probe (posthoc_adjudicate_v1.adjudicate_t2) tested ONLY the k=1 gatefree_machines_sample and ONLY the pre-step lag pair {1,0}: trajs[t][ci] == a*x[t-1] + b*x[t] with a,b nonzero.
